name: japan-trip-offline-build
description: Local build tooling for the offline map + field recorder mini-PWAs (see Makefile / scripts/). Not shipped — only their outputs (map/style.json, map/vendor/*, map/tokyo.pmtiles, map/data/*.geojson, map/fonts/*, map/basemap.mjs, recorder/vendor/*, recorder/data/*.geojson) are served.
